text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Hrm.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Is something troubling you, Bubble?
That's unusual for someone as cheerful as you."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Well, you see, my records have hit a plateau recently.
I was just wondering if there might be a breakthrough somewhere."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. In that case, how about trying something
you wouldn't normally do?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Something I normally don't do... like what?
Whenever I feel like doing most things,
I just jump right in and try them anyway.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Right. You do martial arts,
don't you, Yaeno? Mind if I join in for a trial practice?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Of course. The dojo's gates
are open equally to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: What about that one?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
These are the leftovers from the empty bottles used in the demonstration earlier.
They took on that shape because I chopped off the tops with a knife hand strike.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Alright, decided! I'm gonna do *that*!
Ready?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Are you serious!? For an amateur to pull that off
would be rather difficult, I'm afraid..."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, I'll show you I can do it!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Stopping halfway risks hurting your hand, so please make sure you swing all the way through with momentum.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Banish your fear, steady your breath, and focus!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
......
HAAAAAHHH!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (SMAAAASH!!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Oof, ow ow, my hand is tingling~.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, this is it, isn't it!
Throwing yourself recklessly at something
that seems difficult—this feeling!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Don't treat your daily training like a chore!
Do it fearlessly! Keep it fresh! Make it fun!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From that day forward, Bubble Gum Fellow's running
became even sharper.
